topic.title: Hello World
topic.description: The very first Python program: printing a greeting and taking user input. Introduces the print() and input() functions with basic string usage.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using print() to display output and input() to receive user data. Understanding strings as sequences of characters.
learningNotes.challenges: None — this is the starting point.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Learn about variables and data types.

files.description: Greeting program using print and input.
